scripts.zip: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Add-Type -A System.IO.Compression, System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $src=(Resolve-Path dist).Path; $out=Join-Path (Resolve-Path ..).Path 'BHH_frontend_hostinger.zip'; if (Test-Path $out) { Remove-Item $out }; $zip=[IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($out,'Create'); Get-ChildItem $src -Recurse -File -Force | % { $rel=$_.FullName.Substring($src.Length+1).Replace('\','/'); [void][IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($zip,$_.FullName,$rel,'Optimal') }; $zip.Dispose(); Write-Host 'Linux-compatible zip created at ../BHH_frontend_hostinger.zip'"
scripts.build:zip: npm run build && npm run zip
